facts.fact: The CEMAC QR Code standard, launched 29 July 2026 across six states including the Central African Republic, lets a client with a bank account, mobile money wallet or microfinance account pay by scan whatever their institution.
GIMACPAY, the CEMAC card-mobile-transfer ecosystem in service since 2021, processed over sixteen million mobile transactions in 2025.
